title: spacetime
description: A four-dimensional Lorentzian manifold (M, g) — one world's internal structure read as geometry. Space and time are one continuum; the invariant interval, not separate distance or duration, is what all observers agree on. Under general relativity the metric is dynamic, curving in response to mass-energy and directing motion; its causal (light-cone) structure is the order the entity set carries. The geometric reading of our world.

of-world.description: the world whose internal structure this geometrizes

lorentzian-manifold.description: a 4-dimensional manifold with one time and three space dimensions

metric.description: a Lorentzian metric g (Einstein equations, or the FLRW metric in ΛCDM) giving the invariant interval and the causal order
